title: Position: Reasoning is a Learnable Rule-Based Process
abstract: arXiv:2608.12325v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous reasoning is among the most scientifically and economically motivating topics in AI today. Historically the purview of symbolic AI, recent advances have mainly emerged from deep probabilistic generative models. Despite immense interest and rapid progress, the generative AI community has not clearly converged on operational definitions for reasoning and often implicitly rejects the historical treatment of this topic in logic and verifiable automated reasoning. This position contends that definitional ambiguity leaves the construct validity of reasoning evaluation unverifiable, undermining quantifiable progress toward trustworthy autonomous reasoning. We also contend that this ambiguity is addressable. To that end, we provide (1) operational definitions based on a synthesis of the literature, positioning valid and sound reasoning as a learnable rule-based process; and (2) a checklist for best practices in the communication of AI

translated_title: 立场：推理是一种可学习的基于规则的过程
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12325v1 公告类型：新 摘要：自主推理是当今人工智能中最具科学和经济动机的话题之一。历史上，这属于符号人工智能的领域，但最近的进展主要来自深度概率生成模型。尽管兴趣浓厚且进展迅速，生成式AI社区尚未在推理的操作定义上达成明确共识，并且常常隐含地拒绝在逻辑和可验证的自动推理中对这一主题的历史处理。本立场认为，定义模糊性使得推理评估的构造效度无法验证，削弱了向可信自主推理的可量化进展。我们还认为这种模糊性是可以解决的。为此，我们提供（1）基于文献综合的操作定义，将有效和合理的推理定位为一种可学习的基于规则的过程；（2）AI交流最佳实践的清单。
tldr: 本文主张通过提供操作定义和最佳实践清单，将推理视为可学习的规则化过程，以解决定义模糊性并推动可信自主推理的进展。
en_tdlr: This paper argues for treating reasoning as a learnable rule-based process by providing operational definitions and a checklist for best practices, aiming to address definitional ambiguity and advance trustworthy autonomous reasoning.
